seed.title: Basic Internet Subscription Setup
seed.description: This Blueprint defines an address-based internet subscription and installation workflow. The system checks port availability using the location's infrastructure number, ending immediately if unavailable. If available, the user selects a compatible speed package, a port is allocated, an order is created, and the user is notified before the port is configured and physically connected to complete the setup.
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
bbk = GetBBKByAddress(User.Address)
inventory = GetInventory(bbk)
IF inventory.Available == TRUE THEN
    products = GetProductBySpeed()
    selectedProduct = WaitForUserSelection(products)
    CreateOrder(selectedProduct, User.Address)
END_IF
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

seed.title: Meeting Summary and Action Items
seed.description: This Blueprint retrieves a meeting transcript from the user's Google Drive, uses an LLM to extract a concise meeting summary and the action items that are specifically assigned to the user, and finally sends the results to the user's email.
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
transcript = GetMeetingTranscript(User.Query)
result = ExtractActionItemsAndSummary(transcript, User)
SendEmail(User.Email, "Meeting Summary & Action Items", result)
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

properties.description: Search Google Drive for the meeting transcript document
properties.prompt: Get meeting transcript from Google Drive
properties.label: Get Meeting Transcript

properties.description: Use the LLM to produce a meeting summary and the action items that belong to the current user
properties.prompt: Extract action items and meeting summary for the user from the transcript
properties.label: Extract Action Items and Meeting Summary
properties.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
result = ExtractActionItemsAndSummary(transcript, User)
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

properties.description: Send the meeting summary and the user's action items by email
properties.prompt: Send meeting summary and action items via email
properties.label: Send Email
properties.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
SendEmail(User.Email, "Meeting Summary & Action Items", result)
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

properties.description: Mark the meeting summary workflow as complete
properties.label: Complete
